verdict.rationale: Trivy's CLI supports the exact CI gating pattern via `--exit-code`, confirmed by a hands-on probe showing `trivy fs --exit-code 1` exiting non-zero on findings, and documented in the installation guide; community testimonials also praise its ease of CI/CD integration. The trivy-action GitHub Action (referenced in community evidence) is the common mechanism for running this in PR workflows. Missing for 10: explicit first-party docs/example of a GitHub Actions PR-triggered workflow and support for diffing against a baseline to only fail on 'new' (vs all) findings.
